title: FileListCompleted
description: Result: the immediate (non-recursive, Decision #23) contents of a directory under watch_dir, in reply to a FileListRequested (Design.md §13 Step F3). eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's eventId.

path.description: Directory path, relative to watch_dir, that was listed.

entries.description: One entry per immediate child of `path` — files and subdirectories, not recursed into.

name.description: The entry's own name, not a full path (join with `path` to reconstruct one).

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the listing completed.
